# Bedrock Wiki - AI Readable Documentation

This file provides an overview of the Bedrock Wiki documentation structure for AI consumption.

The Bedrock Wiki is a knowledge-sharing website for technical features of Minecraft Bedrock, containing documentation, tutorials, and general how-to information.

- Website: https://wiki.bedrock.dev
- Repository: https://github.com/Bedrock-OSS/bedrock-wiki (branch: wiki)

## Fetching Pages as Markdown

Every page is served as Markdown as well as HTML, which is easier to process.
There are two equivalent ways to get it:

1. Append `.md` to the page URL.
2. Request the page URL with an `Accept: text/markdown` header.

**Examples:**

- Page URL: https://wiki.bedrock.dev/blocks/blocks-intro
  Markdown: https://wiki.bedrock.dev/blocks/blocks-intro.md

- Page URL: https://wiki.bedrock.dev/guide/introduction
  Markdown: https://wiki.bedrock.dev/guide/introduction.md

The Markdown is the page as written, so some of it comes from the wiki's own
theme rather than standard Markdown:

- `<CodeHeader path="BP/blocks/custom_slab.json" />` names the file that the code
  sample below it belongs to.
- `<Table data="..." />` is replaced by a link to the JSON holding that table's
  rows.
- `<FolderView :paths="[...]" />` lists the files of an example pack.
- `:::tip`, `:::warning` and `:::danger` mark asides, ending at a matching `:::`.

## Searching

The wiki's search index is public. Querying it is usually quicker than working
through the table of contents below:

```
curl -X POST "https://N9ZHAYJQII-dsn.algolia.net/1/indexes/wiki-bedrock/query" \
  -H "X-Algolia-Application-Id: N9ZHAYJQII" \
  -H "X-Algolia-API-Key: a664f5a5da631810a08e1a48554fe523" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "placement position trait"}'
```

Each hit has a `url` pointing at the page and the heading that matched.

## Discovery

- https://wiki.bedrock.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- https://wiki.bedrock.dev/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
